claim_text: The UAE says Iran attacked an ADNOC vessel in the Strait of Hormuz and is urging that the waterway be reopened.
quote: UAE says Iran attacked ADNOC vessel in Hormuz, urges waterway's reopening
confidence_justification: Attribution of the attack comes from an identified state party (the UAE) and is explicitly framed as such; the UAE's call to reopen the waterway is its own on-record position.
